page.overview:
Who is Jolyne Cujoh?

Jolyne Cujoh is Jotaro's daughter in Stone Ocean, awakening Stone Free to survive Green Dolphin Street Prison and fight Pucci.

Also known as: Jolyne, JoJo Part 6.
